releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Fixed Minecraft crashing when loading the mod by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/7
* Messages that are less than 7 characters are now excluded from labeling by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/10
* The mod now only acts upon community labels when the confidence is 0.7 or higher by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/12
* Display settings in a human-readable format by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/13
* Improved message sender recognition by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/16
* 15 no ping on help ask or scammer ads by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/18
* Latest fixes by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/19
* Blocked messages hint by @Schlaumeier5 in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/20

## New Contributors
* @Schlaumeier5 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/pull/7

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Schlaumeier5/EarthMC-Chat-Tools/commits/v1.0.0
